queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
)
SELECT
  timespan,
  cnt AS risk_margin_count,
  cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share,
  cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) - 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM g) AS share_diff
FROM g
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS risk_margin_count, share,
       ABS(share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s)) AS deviation_from_avg_share
FROM s;
WITH g AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS risk_margin_count, share,
       share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS deviation_from_avg_share
FROM s;
WITH c AS (
  SELECT o.timespan AS timespan, COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM riskandmargin r
  JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
s AS (
  SELECT timespan, cnt, cnt * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM c) AS share_pct
  FROM c
)
SELECT timespan, cnt AS risk_margin_count, share_pct,
       share_pct - (SELECT AVG(share_pct) FROM s) AS deviation_pct_points
FROM s;
